reserve_profile.summary: Quantoz states that its stablecoins are backed by cash deposits and government bonds in safeguarded segregated accounts, with reserves exceeding circulation. No token-specific PLNQ allocation is inferred.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Eligible holders have a par-redemption right against Quantoz Payments B.V.; operational access remains subject to onboarding, current terms, and supported channels.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Not established in the reviewed public source set.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Token-specific current fees are not established in the reviewed public source set.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: No universal PLNQ settlement-time guarantee is established in the reviewed public source set.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Customer eligibility, onboarding, sanctions controls, and current issuer terms apply.
Direct operational channel availability is not inferred from the statutory redemption right.
